decision-stated.why: First line and decision section state clearly: delay Android two quarters, redirect engineers to web performance.

rationale-captured.why: Four numbered reasoning points explain why: revenue concentration on web, focused execution, mobile gap not yet critical, and bounded delay. Dissenting view also acknowledged.

options-considered.why: Four options in a table with trade-offs: continue Android on schedule, partial split, full redirect (chosen), and hire/contract. Each has a stated reason for rejection.

reversibility.why: Explicitly labeled as 'two-way door' with nuance: moderate cost, no technical lock-in, but mobile roadmap slips further with each quarter delayed.

owner-and-date.why: Date (2025-07-11) and decider (Product/PM) both stated at the top.

revisit-trigger.why: Four specific triggers listed (churn attributable to Android, early web goals met, competitive escalation, team growth) plus an explicit checkpoint date of end of Q3 2025.
